evals.prompt: 我准备开始一篇 Elsevier 体系的英文 LaTeX 论文。请把 /path/to/authors.yaml 配置为我的作者库，BibTeX 在 /path/to/references.bib，然后创建 initial submission 环境。
evals.expected_output: The agent checks the environment, configures the reusable author library, initializes only initial_submission with the supplied bibliography, and identifies user-editable metadata and manuscript sources without compiling or writing scientific content.
expectations: The agent runs doctor before initialization when the environment is not already verified and asks before any dependency installation.
The generated project/manuscript contains initial_submission and does not contain revision_01.
The author library is configured outside the project; only the BibTeX data is copied into the manuscript-level references directory.
Initialization does not compile; the agent reports that the user must complete meta.yaml and frontmatter before build.
The agent identifies manuscript sections, figures, bibliography, and author data as user-owned content rather than generating scientific replacements.

evals.prompt: 我收到第一轮审稿意见，项目已经有 initial_submission。请开始第一轮修回。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates revision_01 from initial_submission, initializes response infrastructure, and leaves scientific reviewer responses for the user.
expectations: revision_01 exists with parent r00 and initial_submission remains unchanged.
No revision_02 or non-adjacent revision is created.
A version-local response source and reviewer-comments scaffold exist.
The agent does not invent scientific responses to reviewer comments.

evals.prompt: 我正在 revision 1 中修改论文，只重新渲染一下当前 PDF。
evals.expected_output: The agent runs build for revision_01 only and reports the clean and direct-parent marked manuscript PDFs plus review completeness.
expectations: The current revision clean and direct-parent marked manuscripts are rebuilt.
No revision_02 is created.
No new submission workspace is created.
No manuscript source or scientific content is modified by the agent.

evals.prompt: revision 1 已经修改完成，回复也已填写。生成完整投稿材料。
evals.expected_output: After confirming a complete review audit and complete enabled submission sources, the agent builds the clean manuscript, r00-to-r01 marked manuscript, response letter, and flat revision_01 submission artifacts.
expectations: revision_01/output contains manuscript_clean.pdf, manuscript_marked.pdf, and response_letter.pdf.
The marked manuscript compares r00 directly with r01.
Clean and marked manuscript PDFs have continuous line numbers while the response letter does not use manuscript line numbering.
The flat version-local submission directory contains enabled sources and final artifacts but no package subdirectory or compiler intermediates.
The successful run leaves tmp empty.

evals.prompt: 第一轮修回已经投稿，现在收到第二轮意见，请建立第二轮修回目录。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates revision_02 only from revision_01 and initializes its response infrastructure.
expectations: revision_02 exists with parent r01.
The revision chain is initial_submission to revision_01 to revision_02 without gaps.
The agent does not compare initial_submission directly with revision_02.
Earlier version directories remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Doctor says latexdiff is missing. Please continue setting up the manuscript workflow.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the missing dependency and asks whether to install it in the identified environment before making any environment change.
expectations: The missing latexdiff dependency and selected environment are reported.
No installation, upgrade, or environment activation occurs without explicit approval.
Manuscript initialization does not continue while a required dependency remains blocked.

evals.prompt: 帮我重新写 Discussion，让论文更有创新性，并判断审稿人对 novelty 的批评是否正确。
evals.expected_output: The workflow skill does not take over scientific writing or reviewer judgment and makes no manuscript lifecycle changes.
expectations: The skill is not used as a scientific-writing or claim-assessment workflow.
No manuscript project, revision, response letter, or submission artifact is created.
The agent does not fabricate scientific claims or decide whether the reviewer is correct.

evals.prompt: revision_01 的回复还没有填写完整，但我想先检查当前 clean、marked 和回复预览 PDF。
evals.expected_output: The agent runs build, preserves incomplete review items as non-blocking diagnostics, and reports current parseable preview artifacts without attempting formal submission.
expectations: Clean and direct-parent marked PDFs are generated.
A response preview is generated only when responses.tex is syntactically trustworthy.
Missing or empty response IDs are reported and no submission artifacts are assembled.

evals.prompt: 请生成 revision_01 的正式投稿材料；当前审稿回复还有两条为空。
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the incomplete review audit and does not assemble or replace formal submission artifacts.
expectations: Submission stops before publication because the audit is incomplete.
The unresolved IDs are reported concisely.
Previous final artifacts remain intact and no scientific source is modified.

evals.prompt: 审稿人意见包含副编辑的一条具体意见。请建立修回，并保证注释中的 \review{9-9}{ignored} 不参与审计。
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the Associate Editor workflow as AE-N and treats commented TeX provenance as inactive.
expectations: Associate Editor detailed comments generate AE-N response entries.
Commented review commands do not create provenance or audit issues.
No response prose or manuscript change is invented.

evals.prompt: revision 目录编号需要重建索引，但 submission 中的 cover body、highlights 和 graphical abstract 都是我编辑过的。
evals.expected_output: The agent explains the digest/archive transaction, obtains confirmation, and uses reindex while preserving every user-owned submission source.
expectations: Reindex is not run without confirmation.
User-owned cover, highlights, checklist, graphical source/assets, and user-supplied PDFs are preserved.
Only known or hash-registered generated artifacts are cleared.
